name: a big recovered total rolls up into a dated report
looks: A large dollar figure rolls up alone on an otherwise empty field, its digits blurring with speed. It settles, then a short report card fades in beneath it naming a span of weeks and breaking the total down into a handful of labelled line items with their own amounts.
build: The big number rolls up under a vertical blur tied to its speed (same mechanic as data-infographic's roll-up); the report card's rows fade/rise in on a short stagger once the number settles, each row's amount set directly, no further easing.
sound: A rising tone under the roll-up, a soft tick per report row landing.
prompt: Roll up a large recovered-dollar figure alone on an empty field until it settles, then fade in a short dated report card beneath it breaking the total down into a handful of labelled line items with their own amounts, as the film's clearest proof of value.
